## Page 15

Analyst Presentation – 4Q& YE 2025 results
Dividend Payout
On 18 February 2026, a meeting of the Company’s Board of Directors passed a 
resolution to propose to the Annual General Meeting of shareholders to be held in April 
2026 to adopt a resolution to pay a dividend of Baht 11 per share or a total of Baht 8,753 
million, to the shareholders in respect of the 2025 profit and retained earnings. 
 The Company has already paid Baht 2 per share or Baht 1,591 million as an interim 
dividend on August 29, 2025. The remaining Baht 9 per share is divided between year -end 
dividend of Baht 3 per share and Baht 6 per share will be treated as a Special Dividend. 
This remaining Baht 9 per share dividend, or a total of Baht 7,162 million will be paid and 
recorded after it is approved by the Annual General Meeting of the Company’s 
shareholders.
